description: This file defines the FontRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering font objects into RTF format within the MigraDoc document rendering framework. It specifically converts font properties such as name, size, style, color, and script positioning into corresponding RTF control words.

classes.name: FontRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders a font object into RTF control sequences for document formatting.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Converts font properties into RTF commands, such as font name, size, styles, color, and script positioning.
